This e-log book also reflects my patient-centred online learning portfolio and your valuable inputs on the comment box are welcome.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EDate of admission: 16-01-2023\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ECheif complaint :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;A 50 year old male, farmer by occupation came to the opd with the chief complaints of abdominal pain since 1 month .\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHistory of present illness :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic 1 month back then he developed abdominal pain in epigastric region\u0026nbsp; after consumption of food . Pain is present which is squeezing type of pain, non radiating, increases after food consumption and\u0026nbsp; relieving on its own.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPain lasts for 30 minutes during the episode\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo h\/o weight loss , vomitings ,diarrhoea or constipation no loss of appetite , fever ,\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;blood in stools , burning micturition ,\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Eshortness of breath , regurgitation of food.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPast history\u0026nbsp; :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient met with an accident 16 years back , fracture of teeth.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo similar complaints in the past.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EH\/O Hypertension since 1 year (telmisartan 40 mg OD, amlodipine 4 mg)\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EH\/O\u0026nbsp; scabies 1 year ago ( resolved now)\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENot a know case of DM, Asthma, Epilepsy, CAD, TB.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo h\/o drug He was admitted in local hospital and was found to have raised creatinine levels (5.1)\u0026nbsp; ( diagnosed as renal failure). He was under observation for 10days and treated . He was on medication for 5months. Later one month back he developed pedal edema Later 4 days back he developed fever which is intermittent type no diurnal variation , not associated with cough and cold , burning micturition loose stools vomiting , associated with chills\u0026nbsp; and rigors subsided on taking medication.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Ci\u003E\u003Cu\u003EHISTORY OF PAST ILLNESS\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/i\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EH\/O generalized leg pain since 15 years back. He took pain killers ( NSAIDS)( dolo ) for 5-6 years.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EH\/O left hip replacement 10 years back\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EKnow case of hypertension since 5 years ( atenolol)\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo h\/o generalized itching ,\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo h\/o pruritis,\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo h\/o dribbling or increase frequency of urination ,\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo h\/o urgency to urinate\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo h\/o periorbital edema.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo H\/o chest pain, chest tightness.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo h\/o epilepsy, CAD, asthma\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Ci\u003E\u003Cu\u003EPERSONAL HISTORY\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/i\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient is shop keeper by occupation he used to wake up 5 am in the morning and performs his daily activities normally ( brushing , bathing , timely taking food ,adequate sleeping).
